name: Matrei in Osttirol
kurzbeschreibung: The gateway to Nationalpark Hohe Tauern – your starting point for tours into the Venedigergruppe.
beschreibung:
Matrei in Osttirol is situated at an elevation of 975 meters at the entrance to the Tauerntal valley in the district of Lienz. With approximately 4,600 residents, it is the largest market town in East Tyrol. At the confluence of the Isel and Tauernbach rivers, the village extends between the northern foothills of the Venediger Group and the rugged Lienz Dolomites to the south – right where the valley widens gracefully into the Hohe Tauern National Park.

🏞️ Setting out from Matrei, Austria's highest alpine summits are practically at your doorstep: the Venediger Group with the majestic Großvenediger (3,662 m) rises nearby, along with the historic Tauernhaus in Felbertal, one of the oldest alpine shelters in the Alps. The expansive network of hiking trails ranges from leisurely valley strolls along the glacier-fed Isel river to challenging high-alpine tours across glacier terrain. Mountain bikers enjoy scenic routes through the Defereggental and Virgental valleys, while rock climbers tackle the steep crags surrounding the town. In winter, the area transforms into an authentic ski touring haven away from mass tourism. Castle Weißenstein, dating back to the 13th century, watches proudly over the town center as one of East Tyrol's oldest historic landmarks.

Culinary life in Matrei is rich with East Tyrolean heritage: hearty Schlutzkrapfen, delicate Schlipfkrapfen, and crispy Kaspressknödel are traditionally served in historic inns around the market square. Those yearning for peace and natural serenity will find it here – free from bustling commercialism, yet offering direct access to one of the most pristine alpine environments in the Eastern Alps.
